DB0-07.title: Financial columns not at 3 decimal places
DB0-07.rule: OMR authoritative precision is three decimals
closure: All public-table numeric columns classified as money by the executable DB0 detector are required to have scale 3.
The closure migration only widens scale below 3 and increases precision by the same delta, preserving integer capacity.
The migration fails instead of silently rounding any scale above 3 or unbounded numeric money column.
